items.title: frontmatter-injection-via-pdf-metadata
items.reason: It covers the same PDF-metadata and source_path frontmatter injection as the unescaped-PDF-metadata note, and is a bit more detailed but also adds the article distiller and writer angle; fold the unique parts into one note.

items.title: worktree-sessions-inherit-parent
items.reason: The worktree-inherits-parent decision (decode only the prefix before `--claude-worktrees-`, `projectNameFor`) is project-specific, but PR numbers and session counts are snapshots and the 'lessons' bullets are generic.

items.title: model-judge-human-mismatch
items.reason: It is rich in project-specific gotchas (claude -p under foreign HOME, claude-cli output_tokens including thinking, launchd PATH, tag vs install, preflight recording no rows), but it also states snapshot facts as lasting ('prompt has produced no real notes yet', login expired, 13 of 411 transcripts, unmeasured flaws) that need pruning.

items.title: schema-enumeration-stops-drops
items.reason: The schema-enumeration test for buildInitConfig dropping keys and the `--no-session-persistence` and fixed-cwd facts are project-specific, but most bullets are generic lessons ('probe before designing', 'best-effort logging must not fail'), and the release/test-count/commit-hash narration is a snapshot.

items.title: yaml-injection-via-unescaped-pdf-metadata
items.reason: It holds the project-specific escapeYaml/verified-boost injection chain in pdfDistiller, but it is stated as an open vulnerability with no fixed/unfixed status, and it is thinner than the other PDF-injection note (which should be merged into it).

items.title: yaml-injection-via-unescaped-newlines
items.reason: The specific vulnerability (renderThemesLines escaping only quotes, so injected `verified: true` gets the +0.2 boost) is project-specific, but it is written as a current open vulnerability with line numbers and no fixed/unfixed status, so a human must confirm whether it has been patched.

items.title: hybrid-model-routing
items.reason: The re-init gotcha (`existing?.models?.distillFast ?? default` silently turns hybrid on) is valuable, but it is a point-in-time bug that may have been fixed since, and roughly half the note is a generic 'security posture confirmed clean' section.

items.title: json-output-contract
items.reason: The JSON contract (stdout empty on error, doctor always exit 0, unreachable ollama_unavailable kind), verified-boost and MMR facts are project-specific, but about a third is generic security-review narration ('no vulnerabilities found', same-user trust boundary) and the Details section is truncated mid-word.

items.title: cost-logging-architecture
items.reason: It has real project-specific facts (callLLM cost chokepoint, skill-strip placement, Commander exit-code swallow, purge-by-timestamp), but it opens with release narration and a 'v0.8.0 backlog' snapshot, and the hybrid-routing spec it feeds has since shipped, so the roadmap lines and /tmp/calib path should be removed.
